verdict.rationale: Notte's docs state a captcha stance: its remote browser infrastructure advertises built-in captcha solving. The founder separately said it solves about 60% of providers (including reCAPTCHA and Cloudflare), with others still in progress. That is coverage disclosure, not a contradiction, but nothing documents what happens when a captcha goes unsolved, so silent failure is still possible. missing for 10: dedicated captcha documentation listing supported providers, documented failure/error signaling for unsolved captchas, a documented human-in-the-loop fallback (live view exists but is not tied to captcha handling), independent hands-on corroboration of solving.
